//: The browser half, checked separately from the server half on purpose.
The package's root tsconfig has `lib: ["ESNext"]` and no DOM, which is what stops a module in
src/ from reaching for `document` — that code runs in a container and holds the docker socket.
Widening it to give this directory its globals would hand every server module a `document` it must
never touch, so this is a second configuration rather than a looser one.
`include` is this directory only. `src/` is compiled by the root config; nothing here should ever
import from it, because those modules pull in node's filesystem and the socket. The API is the seam
and `ui/src/api.ts` declares the shapes on this side of it.
